contract: A23-74 + A23-88 server: Config.Tutorial.Steps.Forge = 3. [Accept] (step 0, no tier 1 owned) -> step 3 with NO automatic trip (no Fx Travel, no lock, nobody moved; Config.Tutorial.Forge = { Near = 24 } only); a save owning a weapon -> step 1, no trip. Step 3 row 'Go to Otto's Forge' (Pinned, ShortName 'To the Forge', not claimable); the walker's first arrival within 24 studs of the anvil fires QuestService.ForgeReached(player, seconds since [I'm In!]) once (TelemetryService: Custom ForgeWalk) - only for a walk begun this session; RequestTutorial at step 3 does nothing; meadow kills before the gift count nothing. The anvil prompt at step 3 (ShopService -> QuestService.ForgeGift): Otto's line ('The Squishy Meadow is next.'), LootService.GrantFirstWeapon (tier 1 equipped, 'Power 0 -> N'), step 1 'Travel to Squishy Meadow - step on the glowing travel pad (or Map -> Travel)' (ShortName 'To the meadow'), no weapon window, no automatic trip; any arrival in the meadow (the pad, Map -> Travel, a walk) starts the hunt (step 2). The claim always clears BlacksmithVisited (M1_1 = a new visit: Otto's lines, Gold 1, then the shop where the 150 gold buy tier 2) and says Claimed (next weapon) unless a better weapon is owned (ClaimedArmed). Old saves at steps 1 / 2 / 99, class chosen, bare-handed without tier 1 get the gift at the join (once a session; never at steps 0 / 3, never when armed). No anvil: the gift at once. The Forge step survives a save / load.
limitations: Offline doubles for Players, characters, the anvil part, ZoneService (Travel / ZoneChanged) and the services the combat world stubs; StoryQuestService runs without its 1 s loop (the test calls Refresh, as the anvil does). The client side (the path light to the Forge, the glowing travel pad, the one-time speech bubble, the Stronger! moment) is game dev 1's contract; the walking time (20-40 s) and an unblocked path are checked in the live map (main Play).
